# Contributing to OpenEverything

Start with the [contribution guide](../docs/013-contributing.md) for setup, focused checks, and small contribution ideas. For a quick overview, read the [English introduction](../docs/016-readme-en.md) or [中文首页](../README.md).

Please keep credentials and private runtime data out of issues and pull requests. Report vulnerabilities using the [security policy](../docs/014-security.md).
